name: next
headline: What comes *next*
visualData: One app on every desktop — Windows, macOS and Linux · one protocol · hosts your hive
Source in the hive — read it, change it, try it on your own domain
say: What comes next. One app for every desktop, Windows, macOS and Linux, held to the same open protocol, and able to host your hive itself. And the platform's own source, living in the hive, so anyone can read it, change it, and try the change on their own domain.
